description: Make an AI chat call through Chain Receipt and get a signed, Bitcoin-anchored receipt for it. Needs a Chain Receipt API key (send it as the Authorization bearer token when connecting). Returns the model's answer plus the receipt id, hash, signature and verify URL. One receipt per call, counted against the org's monthly quota like any proxy call.

customer_ref.description: Your own reference for this call, stored on the receipt.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the model's reply.

messages.description: The chat messages to send to the model.

provider_key.description: Provider API key for this call only. Omit to use the org's stored provider key.

name: create-receipt
title: Create receipt
